categories.main_business_segments: Hubei Huitian New Materials Co., Ltd primarily operates in the adhesive materials industry, focusing on high-performance, environmentally friendly engineering adhesives. Key business segments include adhesives for electronics, automotive, photovoltaic (solar energy), and packaging industries. The company also produces related chemical products such as automotive brake fluids, lubricants, and sealing materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced industrialized production technologies including fully automated twin-screw extrusion lines for organosilicon and polyurethane adhesives. It holds numerous patents (over 200) and has developed proprietary formulations for high thermal conductivity interface materials, structural adhesives, and environmentally friendly solvent-free adhesives. Digital manufacturing execution systems (MES) and warehouse management systems (WMS) are employed to optimize production efficiency and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are industrial manufacturers in electronics (including consumer electronics, automotive electronics, and semiconductor packaging), automotive (especially new energy vehicles), photovoltaic industry players, and soft packaging companies. Major clients include leading domestic and international companies such as BYD, CATL, Longi Green Energy, Trina Solar, and various automotive OEMs and electronics manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Hubei (Xiangyang, Yicheng), Guangzhou, Shanghai, Changzhou, and Anqing. It also has overseas subsidiaries and sales networks in Southeast Asia, India, the Middle East, Japan, and Vietnam, supporting export and international market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huitian New Materials operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of specialty adhesives and related chemical materials. It sources raw materials such as organosilicon polymers and polyethers and supplies finished adhesive products to downstream industrial manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment focusing on high-performance, environmentally friendly adhesives tailored for emerging industries like photovoltaics, new energy vehicles, electronics, and packaging. Strategic R&D projects include development of thermal conductive gels, elastic structural adhesives for batteries, solvent-free packaging adhesives, and advanced sealing materials. Collaborations with academic institutions and national innovation centers support technology leadership and product innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of adhesive products and related chemical materials to industrial customers. The company uses a combination of direct sales to large industrial clients and distribution through dealers. It also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies but product sales constitute the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Huitian New Materials is a leading domestic player and one of the largest adhesive manufacturers in China, recognized as a market leader in engineering adhesives. It competes with international giants like Henkel and other domestic mid-to-large scale adhesive producers. The company leverages its broad product portfolio, strong R&D, and localized service to maintain a leading position and accelerate import substitution in high-end adhesive segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.99 billion, a 2.23% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 101.85 million, down 65.91% due to industry challenges. The company has steadily expanded production capacity and invested heavily in R&D, with a focus on sustainable growth and market share expansion in key sectors. Total assets reached about RMB 6.59 billion, reflecting ongoing capital investments and acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huitian New Materials emphasizes high-quality, high-performance, and environmentally friendly adhesive solutions tailored to critical applications in photovoltaics, automotive electronics, and packaging. Its products often match or exceed international standards, offering superior cost-effectiveness and localized support. The company’s strong innovation capability, extensive patent portfolio, and integrated digital manufacturing processes provide customers with reliable, advanced adhesive technologies that enhance product performance and manufacturing efficiency.
